name: Visionect frame
description: A Visionect e-paper frame (Place & Play 32", Joan, the 13" boards) driven directly, with no Visionect Software Suite. The frame dials the server address in its flash on TCP 11113; Tesserae listens there, renders a 16-level grey picture and pushes it over the frame's own protocol (pyvisionect). Point the frame at this host: run Tesserae where the old Visionect server ran, or set the address over the frame's USB console. The protocol has no authentication, so keep port 11113 on your LAN. Leave the UUID blank to bind the first unknown frame that connects within an hour. Quiet hours with sleep-through put the frame into deep sleep until the window ends.

uuid.label: Frame UUID
uuid.help: The frame's UUID, e.g. 36002000-1247-3830-3933-303600000000 (on the label, or in the old Visionect server's device list). Leave blank and the first unknown frame that connects within an hour of adding the device (or clearing this field) is bound to it; later ones are listed as discovered devices.

heartbeat_min.label: Sleep interval
heartbeat_min.help: How long the frame sleeps between check-ins. Tesserae writes it to the frame the next time it connects and saves it to the frame's flash. Custom value is in minutes.

frame_sleep.label: Sleep between check-ins

choices.label: Leave as the frame has it

frame_sleep.help: Whether the frame sleeps between check-ins. Staying awake keeps Wi-Fi on and drains the battery; use it only on mains power.

touch_mode.label: Touch

choices.label: Leave as the frame has it

touch_mode.help: Whether the frame reacts to touch, and whether it beeps.

system_screens.label: System screens

choices.label: Leave as the frame has it

system_screens.help: Which built-in status screens the frame may draw itself: the low-battery screen, the not-connected screen, or both.

roaming_mode.label: Wi-Fi roaming

choices.label: Leave as the frame has it

roaming_mode.help: Lets the frame move to a stronger access point of the same network.

wifi_region.label: Wi-Fi region

choices.label: Leave as the frame has it

wifi_region.help: The regulatory region the Wi-Fi radio uses.

wifi_mode.label: Wi-Fi power mode

choices.label: Leave as the frame has it
No broadcast filtering, enhanced power save

wifi_mode.help: Wi-Fi power saving behaviour. Leave on default unless the frame misses updates.

epd_border.label: Panel border

choices.label: Leave as the frame has it

epd_border.help: The colour of the panel's border pixels.

charging_mode.label: Battery charging

choices.label: Leave as the frame has it

charging_mode.help: Charging off stops the battery charging from its supply.

ble_mode.label: Bluetooth

choices.label: Leave as the frame has it

ble_mode.help: Whether the frame's Bluetooth radio is on.
